# Zors.o purple theme

Look and textures by Zors.o (Steam: https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199099877561): purple
menu backgrounds, splash, cursors (with a purple crosshair) and world icons (extinguisher, repair,
reload, scrap, upgrade, under construction).

Installed with the compact HUD in purple: the menu backgrounds into every menu skin folder under
`data\ui\textures\menu_backgrounds`, the splash as `data\ui\earthworkgames.png`, the rest into
`data\ui\textures`.
